notes.title: Content Update: Halloween Catsuit and Sex Machine Animation
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this special Halloween content update we've got a special trick and treat for you!

First off, we've added a brand new catsuit costume that would make Michelle Pfeiffer blush. All three models can sport the new outfit from the "Clothing" menu.

We've also added a new animation that introduces a sex machine! Capture the action as the vixens enjoy some solo action. To access the new animation, simply click on the "new" tag from the tag list on the "Pose" selection screen.

And finally, we did fix a couple of minor bugs along the way.

As always, this content update is free if you own the game. And for those on the fence, you can get the TruXposure VR 33% off this weekend (until October 30th, 1:00 p.m. EST). Come join the fun!

Cheers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902280/TruXposure_VR/

notes.title: Content Update: 3 Sexy Poses and a School Girl Uniform Set
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for all your support so far. It's exactly the fuel we need to continue adding more content and features!

In this first content update we are adding 3 brand new sexy poses/animations. To find them, simply click on the "new" tag which has been added to the tag list on the pose selection screen.

We're also super excited about the addition of a new school girl outfit for all three of our beautiful vixens. You can easily navigate to it in the clothing menu screen.

To mark this special occasion, we've also just launched a week-long discount of 10% which starts today. Don't miss out! 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Feature Update: In-game Photo Gallery
notes.notes:
Greetings!

First off, we'd like to extend a big "thank you" to everyone who'se supported the game since it's launch just a couple of weeks ago. We're very grateful to see such interest in our game!

But the journey doesn't end there. As stated before, we have many plans to continuously improve the core experience and provide even more content for you to enjoy.

To that end, we're very pleased to release our first update today, which introduces a brand new Photo Gallery feature. Now, when you go to the main menu, you will have the option to view the photos you've taken inside the game, in full VR glory! (Of course, you can still access your photos at any time from your local data folder.)

We hope you like this new addition to the game and we're hard at work on even more sexy updates ;-)

Stay tuned!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902280/TruXposure_VR
